This is crucial for maintaining the integrity of the data being processed and ensuring that the northbound plugins do not have to handle prefix masking themselves.

In `ripd/rip_cli.c`, the change to the `rip_distance_source` command is related to the overall goal of ensuring that the distance value is correctly modified and communicated through the northbound interface. This change complements the adjustments made in `rip_northbound.c` by ensuring that the user interface correctly reflects the intended behavior of the distance command, which is now more robust due to the earlier changes in prefix handling. 

Overall, the modifications in both files work together to enhance the reliability and correctness of the routing information protocol (RIP) implementation, particularly in how it interacts with northbound interfaces and user commands.
